message.content: The kernel calibrates the scale on the bulk of the row (with `pctl_levels=2`, the threshold ends up being roughly the 3rd-largest |x|) and then clamps to ±127·scale. On heavy-tailed rows, outlier channels get clamped away entirely, which the contract explicitly says the 5% bound cannot absorb. I'll record that claim and probe it.

message.reasoning_content: The kernel clamps outliers to ±127·scale where scale is calibrated to the bulk (2nd largest |x| for pctl_levels=2... actually thresh after 2 iterations = 3rd largest abs value). Heavy-tailed rows with outliers > bulk by orders of magnitude will clamp those channels, violating the 5% relative error requirement. Record claim and run probe.
